canDoYue: 你識帶細袋上機、問幾早去入境處，再聽落地次序：先入境，再行李轉盤，最後海關。
canDoEn: Check a small bag on board, ask when to reach immigration, then hear the arrival order: immigration, the carousel, then customs.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Can I take this small bag on board and check the big one?
dialogue.glossYue: 我可唔可以帶呢個細袋上機，大袋托運？
dialogue.say: Can I take this small bag on board and check the big one?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Take the small bag on board. Collect the big one at the carousel after immigration.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。細袋帶上機。入境之後喺行李轉盤攞大袋。
dialogue.say: Yes. Take the small bag on board. Collect the big one at the carousel after immigration.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: If the flight leaves at two, how early should I reach immigration with one bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果航班兩點走，我應該幾早帶住一個袋去入境處？
dialogue.say: If the flight leaves at two, how early should I reach immigration with one bag?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Please reach immigration by one o'clock, because your layover flight leaves at two.
dialogue.glossYue: 請一點前去入境處，因為你轉機嗰班兩點起飛。
dialogue.say: Please reach immigration by one o'clock, because your layover flight leaves at two.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: After I land, is immigration before the baggage carousel, please?
dialogue.glossYue: 落地之後，入境處係咪喺行李轉盤之前？
dialogue.say: After I land, is immigration before the baggage carousel, please?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Please go through immigration first. The carousel is next.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。請先過入境處。跟住就係行李轉盤。
dialogue.say: Yes. Please go through immigration first. The carousel is next.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Do I clear customs before I collect the bag?
dialogue.glossYue: 我攞行李之前，使唔使先過海關？
dialogue.say: Do I clear customs before I collect the bag?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: No. Collect the bag at the carousel. Then go through customs with your declaration.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔使。先喺行李轉盤攞袋。跟住帶申報表過海關。
dialogue.say: No. Collect the bag at the carousel. Then go through customs with your declaration.
